titleEn: Articles with general and specific nouns
titleAr: أدوات التعريف مع الكلام العام والخاص
explanationAr: عندما نتحدث بشكل عام عن اسم غير معدود أو جمع، لا نستخدم the: Steel is stronger than wood. Engineers need good communication skills. وعندما نقصد شيئًا محددًا نستخدم the: The steel for this project arrived late. وانتبه إلى العبارات الثابتة: at work و at home و by car دون the، و the same و the first و the best مع the.
explanationEn: When you speak in general about an uncountable or plural noun, do not use the: Steel is stronger than wood. Engineers need good communication skills. When you mean something specific, use the: The steel for this project arrived late. Learn fixed phrases: at work, at home, by car (no the), and the same, the first, the best (with the).
